objective: Derive exact quote-rate and bind-rate fractions from canonical acquisition outcome analytics without introducing floating-point percentages, display rounding, persistence, or new lifecycle inference.
rules: The denominator for both quoteRate and bindRate is canonical relationshipCount.
bindRate is not defined as boundRelationshipCount divided by quotedRelationshipCount.
A zero relationship denominator produces no rate value.
A positive denominator with zero outcomes produces an exact 0/N rate.
Counts must be safe non-negative integers.
Quoted and bound relationship counts cannot exceed relationshipCount.
The pure rate layer performs no division and therefore introduces no floating-point or rounding policy.
Presentation layers may later format exact fractions as percentages under a separately defined display policy.
